concerns.location: tasks.md:T005, T006, T008, T009, T011, T012 [P] tags
concerns.text: Tasks tagged [P] carry explicit producer→consumer dependencies: T006 consumes labels.csv from T005 ('after T005' per Dependencies section), T008 consumes regressor.pt (T006) and descriptors_novel.csv (T013), T009 consumes validation_results.csv (T008), T011/T012 consume nearly all prior artifacts. [P] must denote parallel-safe; these are not. Remove [P] from dependent tasks or restrict it to genuinely independent siblings.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T010 vs T012 vs 'Execution order' line
concerns.text: T010 'wraps the full pipeline' with runtime/RAM enforcement, yet the stated execution order is '…T014 → T010 → T011 → T012' (monitor last), while T012's run_all.sh 'sequentially runs T002→T010, T014' (monitor before T014). These two sequences disagree, and a wrapper placed after everything it must measure cannot observe the full run without re-execution. Pick one consistent order and clarify whether T010 wraps T014 as well.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T013 placement in Phase 3 vs execution order
concerns.text: T013 appears in Phase 3 after T005/T006 (Phase 2) but is listed first in the execution order 'T005 → T006 → T013 → T008'. The phase grouping is fine, but T013 is independent of T005/T006 and could precede them; more importantly the document gives two orderings (phase listing vs execution-order line) for T013/T008 — make the canonical order unambiguous.
